answer: Agent economies can bind each identity to a hardware-rooted crystal oscillator whose drift is continuously attested, so a single physical device cannot cheaply spawn many wallets. Each registration must solve a basalt-anchored proof-of-work cipher seeded by that oscillator's attested entropy, making mass identity creation cost real energy rather than a database insert. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
